record_fields.supersedes_record_id: nullable prior record id; corrections append
record_fields.source_reference: nullable safe URL or document id
record_fields.decided_by: human id/role or oriva_system for non-binding next steps

immutability_rules: Never edit or delete a prior ledger record after evidence acquisition starts.
Corrections append a new record and set supersedes_record_id.
Technical failures use TECHNICAL_FAILURE and cannot carry a negative commercial finding.
Expired evidence remains visible and may be superseded but not erased.
A decision must reference the records that support it.
Human decisions identify the human role; Oriva may propose only non-binding next steps.
